title: dot-agents canonical proposal
description: JSON Schema for formal dot-agents proposal artifacts (.agents/proposals/<id>.yaml for project-local or ~/.agents/proposals/<id>.yaml for global). A proposal captures an idea or change request before it graduates to a spec/plan. Informal project-local research artifacts use .md format and are not validated by this schema. The scope field is the canonical discriminator: 'global' maps to ~/.agents/proposals/ and applies to shared resources (rules, skills, hooks, settings) that affect all projects; 'project-local' maps to .agents/proposals/ and applies to project-specific design docs, ADRs, or workflow specs that have not yet graduated to workflow/specs/<id>/design.md.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; should match the filename (without extension) under proposals/.

status.description: Lifecycle status. draft → work in progress; in_review → awaiting maintainer ruling; approved → accepted but not yet implemented; rejected → decided against; promoted → graduated to a canonical spec/plan (see promoted_at, promoted_to_spec, promoted_to_plan); deferred → on hold for a later cycle.

scope.description: Optional but recommended routing discriminator (may be inferred from the artifact's directory when absent). 'global' = artifact lives under ~/.agents/proposals/ and targets a shared resource (rule, skill, hook, MCP config, or global setting) that applies across all projects managed by dot-agents. 'project-local' = artifact lives under .agents/proposals/ and targets something specific to one project (design doc, ADR, workflow spec in ideation, research artifact). Decision heuristic: if this repo were removed from dot-agents management, would the proposal still matter? Yes → global; No → project-local.

type.description: Category of the artifact being proposed. Common values: skill, rule, hook, setting, design, research, decision. Open string — not enum-constrained because the set is open-ended.

action.description: What this proposal intends to do to the target. Common values: create, update, remove, promote, revise. Open string — not enum-constrained.

target.description: Location or entity this proposal acts on. May be a single path string (e.g. 'internal/scaffold/home/starter/skills/global/kg-ideate/') or a structured object with named sub-targets (e.g. {starter_source: ..., installed_at: ...}).

rationale.description: Why this proposal is needed. Use block scalar (|-) in YAML when the text contains ': ' to avoid parse errors.

content.description: The full proposal body — the canonical artifact content. May include inline Markdown, SKILL.md drafts, instruction files, templates, or other authoring artifacts. Use block scalar (|) in YAML.

created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the proposal was authored.

created_by.description: Author identifier. Typically a model identifier (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6) or a human handle.

promoted_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the proposal was promoted to a canonical spec/plan. Only present when status=promoted.

promoted_to_spec.description: Path to the canonical spec this proposal was promoted to (e.g. .agents/workflow/specs/<id>/design.md). Only present when status=promoted.

promoted_to_plan.description: Path to the canonical plan directory this proposal was promoted to (e.g. .agents/workflow/plans/<id>/). Only present when status=promoted.

reviewed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp stamped by `da review approve` when the proposal was reviewed. Written during the review/approval lifecycle; may be empty or absent on unreviewed drafts.

review_reason.description: Free-text reviewer note recorded by `da review approve` (may be an empty string). Explains the review decision when non-empty.
